Learn about the basics of the game from the Nameless Masters. This quest is primarily for newly created [[PvP-only character]]s, but also available to [[roleplaying character]]s.

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
*Speak with [3...0] more master[s] on the training grounds of the [[Isle of the Nameless]].
*Return to [[the Guide]] on the Isle of the Nameless.

===Reward===
*''None

==Walkthrough==
Head to the main area of the isle. There, talk to three nameless masters other than [[Master of Winds]]; the closest ones are [[Master of Combat]], [[Master of Magic (NPC)|Master of Magic]] and [[Master of Area Effects]].

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;The Guide
:''"You are eager for knowledge, I see. Good! That is good, indeed. There are many things you can learn by keeping your eyes and ears open, but the quickest students actively seek answers. Behind me, you can see our training grounds. To get there, take the flight of stairs down, then take the flight of stairs you will find to your immediate left. There are many '''masters''' in the training ground, and you must speak with at least '''3''' of them. Return to me with the knowledge you find.''
:''If you accept this quest, It {{sic|'It' is capitalized}} will appear in your [[Quest Log]], Press {{sic|There is a comma there and 'Press' is capitalized after the comma}} '''L''' to view your Quest Log. Double {{sic|Clicking the name of a quest doesn't require double clicking}} clicking the name of a quest will re-highlight your next goal on the [[Mission Map|mini-map]]."''
{{Offer dialog
| accept = Sounds easy. I'm ready.
| decline = I don't need you, {{sic|Comma before 'or'}} or your masters.
| ask = You must follow the stairs down to our training grounds and speak to at least '''3''' of the '''masters''' there. If you require further direction, follow the green star on your mini-map or consult your '''Quest Log'''.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;The Guide
:''"Ah yes, that is very true, young one.''
:''I think you are ready for a greater challenge. If you feel you are ready, you may wander the shores outside our humble keep and fight the masters you find there.''
:''Otherwise, the next step in your training is to see the [[Master of Paths]] and learn about the many different types of combat. We will talk more of this shortly."''

==Notes==
*The quest marker will lead you to the Master of Combat, followed by Master of Magic and then Master of Conditions; however, you can speak any of the friendly masters in any order.
